top_choice_rationale: Palladium-catalysed C-N cross-coupling is a mature, structurally and mechanistically well-evidenced enabling method: ligand design made a general reaction that the whole community uses in pharmaceuticals and materials, with clean two-name credit (Buchwald, Hartwig) and a narrow, defensible citation. P002 (targeted protein degradation) is scientifically strong with solved ternary structures but is clinically unproven and has a contested credit boundary around the molecular-glue strand, so it ranks second ahead of no award.
